note: DEMO regulatory records. These are synthetic Quality Control Order entries created for the SIH26107 prototype. They are NOT official notifications, they carry is_verified=false and is_mock=true, and the UI labels every one of them as demo data. Standards deliberately absent from this file (DEMO-STD-002, DEMO-STD-003, DEMO-STD-006, DEMO-STD-008) exercise the UNABLE_TO_VERIFY path: absence of a regulatory record is never reported as 'voluntary'. QCO-DEMO-005 carries a future effective date so the UPCOMING status is exercised: a notified order that is not yet in force is reported as UPCOMING with its date, not as an existing breach.
